attack.en: It was heavily defended from the sea, where the Ottomans expected any attack to come.
attack.zh: 奥斯曼人预料攻击会来自海上，因此在海防方面戒备森严。

attack.en: “I do not order you to attack,” he said, “I order you to die.”
attack.zh: “我不是命令你们进攻，”他说，“我是命令你们去死。”

attack.en: The centuries of attacks from various different empires and armies significantly weakened Constantinople.
attack.zh: 来自各个不同帝国和军队的数百年攻击大大削弱了君士坦丁堡。

attack.en: Hannibal's men, well-rested and hidden in ambush positions, attacked the Romans while they were mid-stream.
attack.zh: Hannibal养精蓄锐、潜伏在埋伏地点的部下，趁罗马人走到河中央时发起了进攻。

attack.en: Many in Turkey, particularly in the countryside, saw these reforms as an attack on their traditions.
attack.zh: 土耳其的许多人，尤其是乡间的人，将这些改革视为对他们传统的攻击。

atmosphere.en: Caroline Steele says that scientists are looking at the potential atmosphere around TRAPPIST-1e.
atmosphere.zh: Caroline Steele 表示，科学家们正在研究 TRAPPIST-1e 周围的潜在大气层。

atmosphere.en: Indeed. And Caroline goes on to say how the atmosphere of TRAPPIST-1e is dominated by nitrogen.
atmosphere.zh: 的确。Caroline 接着说到 TRAPPIST-1e 的大气层是如何被氮气主导的。

atmosphere.en: And most importantly of all, create a stress-free atmosphere by not pressurising kids to finish everything on their plate.
atmosphere.zh: 最重要的是，不要强迫孩子们吃光盘子里的所有东西，从而营造一个轻松无压力的氛围。

atmosphere.en: Alongside sharks, another species that Trisha believes is important to helping remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere is the wildebeest.
atmosphere.zh: 除了鲨鱼，Trisha 认为角马也是有助于从大气中清除二氧化碳的重要物种。

atmosphere.en: So, for perspective, some experts say that we need to suck 10 gigatonnes of CO2 a year out of the atmosphere to meet our climate goals.
atmosphere.zh: 打个比方，一些专家认为，为了实现气候目标，我们每年需要从大气中吸走 100 亿吨的二氧化碳。

athlete.en: I’m not saying that the Winter Olympians didn’t work hard to become great athletes.
athlete.zh: 我并不是说冬奥选手没有通过努力工作来成为伟大的运动员。

athlete.en: A confident athlete still feels pressure before running in the Olympic 100-meter race.
athlete.zh: 一个自信的运动员在参加奥运会百米赛跑前依然会感受到压力。

athlete.en: There's something going on in the brain when the athletes are making quick decisions.
athlete.zh: 当运动员们做出快速决策时，他们的大脑中正在发生着某些变化。

athlete.en: We're watching these athletes make decisions in split instincts, under the highest pressures and the highest intensities.
athlete.zh: 我们正在观察这些运动员在极高的压力和极高的强度下，凭直觉瞬间做出决策。

athlete.en: He was simply naturally gifted, naturally talented at being an athlete.
athlete.zh: 他只是作为一个运动员有着天然的赋能、天然的天赋。

attach.en: Electrodes were attached to his wrist. The door was closed.
attach.zh: 电极被绑在他的手腕上，房门随即关闭。

attach.en: The vocabulary was attached to a real life action, something that I could see, something that I could do.
attach.zh: 词汇与现实生活中的动作联系在了一起，这是我能看到的、我能做到的事。

attach.en: And the prefix post- expresses something that happens after or as a result of the event it's attached to.
attach.zh: 前缀 post- 表示在它所附加的事件之后或作为其结果发生的事情。

attach.en: I think many of you listening might be aware of corruption and have attached your own meanings or your own images to the term.
attach.zh: 我想听节目的各位很多可能对腐败有所耳闻，并在这个词上附加了你们自己的理解或形象。

attach.en: How he did this was by attaching a cannonball to a piece of long rope, and then lowering it off the side of the boat.
attach.zh: 他是怎么做的呢？他把一个加农炮弹绑在一根长绳子上，然后把它从船边放下去。

attempt.en: My first speech contest attempt was in 2017, within the first year of me studying Japanese.
attempt.zh: 我第一次尝试演讲比赛是在2017年，那是我学习日语的第一年。

attempt.en: This word attempts to capture the mood, trends and changes in our society.
attempt.zh: 这个词试图捕捉我们社会的士气、趋势和变化。

attempt.en: The first key to becoming an expert is simple, but powerful: you need repeated attempts.
attempt.zh: 成为专家的第一个关键很简单，但很有力量：你需要重复尝试。

attempt.en: He also attempted to end his own life by jumping onto train tracks in London.
attempt.zh: 他甚至曾试图跳入伦敦的火车轨道来结束自己的生命。

attempt.en: And, after all, this was far from the only attempt on Hitler’s life.
attempt.zh: 而且，毕竟这绝不是唯一一次谋杀希特勒的企图。

atom.en: Then, a neutron is fired at the nucleus of a Uranium-235 atom, splitting it.
atom.zh: 接着，一个中子被发射到铀-235原子的原子核上，将其分裂。

atom.en: In other words, atoms could break down and could release energy.
atom.zh: 换句话说，原子可以分解并释放能量。

atom.en: The Curies work demonstrated that atoms were not indivisible.
atom.zh: 居里夫妇的工作证明了原子并非不可分割。

atom.en: The Pandora’s Box of splitting the atom had been opened, so the world should at least reap the benefits of what was inside.
atom.zh: 分裂原子的潘多拉魔盒已经打开，所以世界至少应该收获其中的益处。

atom.en: And there is also the promise, or at least the allure, of nuclear fusion, the other kind of nuclear power, the one that works by fusing atoms together rather than splitting them apart.
atom.zh: 还有核聚变的承诺，或者至少是它的诱惑力。这是另一种核能，它通过将原子融合在一起而不是将它们分裂来工作。

attendant.en: Stonehouse was in his swimming trunks, he had handed his clothes to an attendant, and waded out into the crystal clear water.
attendant.zh: Stonehouse 穿着泳裤，把衣服交给了一名服务员，然后走进了清澈见底的海水中。

attendant.en: A couple of minutes later, an attendant came in and knocked von Stauffenberg on the shoulder: Sir, there’s a telephone call for you.
attendant.zh: 几分钟后，一名随从进来拍了拍冯·施陶芬贝格的肩膀：长官，有您的电话。

attendant.en: When the king falls into one of these episodes, when he shouts or attacks the attendants around him or becomes impossible to manage, Willis orders for him to be put into a straitjacket, those jackets where your arms are tied down securely around your body so you cannot move, the ones that are sometimes used for violent prisoners.
attendant.zh: 当国王陷入这些发作之一、当他大喊大叫或攻击身边的侍从或者变得无法管教时，Willis 命令把他穿上束衣，就是那种把你的手臂牢牢绑在身体两侧让你无法动弹的衣服，有时用于暴力囚犯的那种。

attribute.en: The quote is attributed to Winston Churchill.
So, let me leave you with a quote widely attributed to Percy Fawcett, which seems to sum up his attitude rather well.
attribute.zh: 因此，我想留给各位一句广泛认为是 Percy Fawcett 所说的话，这句话似乎很好地总结了他的态度。

athletic.en: He had never played American football in his life, but he was naturally athletic.
athletic.zh: 他这辈子从来没玩过美式橄榄球，但他天生运动神经发达。

athletic.en: They were clearly very athletic and talented, but watching their interviews, it also became clear they were very advantaged.
athletic.zh: 他们显然非常有运动天赋，但看着他们的采访，也很明显看出他们极具优势。
